name: Home Assistant
description: Home automation that keeps your devices and their data at home.
notes: It uses host networking, so it can find devices on your network and is reached on port 8123. On the first visit, create your user. Bluetooth works through this computer's D-Bus. A USB stick (Zigbee, Z-Wave) has to be added under devices in the Compose tab: NimbusOS doesn't run Home Assistant privileged, unlike its own example. This installation type has no add-ons.
